Chesapeake Bay from Sandy Point to North Beach-
127 PM EST Mon Nov 9 2026

...SMALL CRAFT ADVISORY IN EFFECT UNTIL MIDNIGHT EST TONIGHT...

.THIS AFTERNOON...NW winds 20 kt with gusts to 25 kt. Waves 3 ft. 
.TONIGHT...NW winds 10 to 15 kt with gusts to 20 kt... becoming W
5 kt late. Waves 1 to 2 ft. 
.TUE...SW winds 5 to 10 kt. Waves 1 ft. 
.TUE NIGHT...NW winds 5 to 10 kt. Waves 1 ft. 
.WED...E winds around 5 kt. Waves 1 ft or less. 
.WED NIGHT...SE winds 5 to 10 kt. Waves 1 ft. 
.THU...E winds 10 kt...becoming N 20 to 25 kt. Waves 1 to 2 ft...
building to 4 ft after midnight. A chance of rain in the morning.
Rain.
.FRI...NW winds 25 to 30 kt. Waves 4 ft. Rain likely in the morning,
then a chance of rain through the night.
